C0498.title: Video Injection Attack Detection: Countering Virtual Camera Bypass in Remote Biometric Systems
C0498.summary: Academic research reveals that attackers leverage deepfake technology and virtual camera software to inject pre-recorded or synthetic video streams directly into the identity authentication pipeline, bypassing the physical camera interface to deceive facial recognition systems.
